about: Realm parallax manifest. Human spec: REALM.md. Inputs are hand-written; required, size, anchor, tiles, tileCell, grid, memoryMB, landmarks, biomeLocal, keepClear, instances, cell, cellWorstCase, particles, poolMax and budget are derived by `node camera.js --build` (never edit them by hand). `node camera.js --test` checks it.

camera.mapScale: device viewport -> map points: letterbox outside aspect [0.45, 3.6]; s = max(w/2560, h/1440) if larger, min(w/568, h/320) if smaller, else 1; V = box / s

flyTo.target: clampCamera(node, zoom, V) (hard clamp): east-edge nodes (PM, CR, CM) land at the pan limit with the node right of centre, instead of flying past it and springing back

feel.keyboard: no pan keys (the game owns letters and arrows); '-' and '=' zoom by one wheel notch unless a layer hotkey claims them

LOW.select: TouchEnabled and not KeyboardEnabled, or GuiService.ViewportDisplaySize == Small, or SavedQualityLevel <= 3; the player can override in Options

tiling.rule: uniform grid per layer; tile content tw x th texture px + a 2 px gutter copied from the neighbours (clamped at the layer edge); LOW = HIGH scale / 2 and merges 2x2 HIGH tiles
tiling.placement: snap every tile edge to a whole device pixel, shared by the neighbours: X0 = round(m * (Ox + s * lx)), X1 = round(m * (Ox + s * (lx + lw))) relative to the Box (m = device px per map point), Position = fromOffset(X0, Y0), Size = fromOffset(X1 - X0, Y1 - Y0), no UIScale between the Box and the tiles; no overlap (REALM.md 9.3)
tiling.alphaBleed: every transparent pixel gets the colour of its nearest opaque pixel (alpha stays 0) before PNG export
tiling.dropEmpty: a tile whose max alpha < 2/255 is not uploaded; the client skips it

footprint.note: world px around a node centre: ring + socket glow + nameplate below

atmosphere.formula: per pixel, sRGB 0..1: L = luma709(c); c1 = L + (c - L) * saturation; c2 = lumaHaze + (c1 - lumaHaze) * contrast; k = haze + hazeBottom * smoothstep(0.35, 1, y / h); c3 = mix(c2, hazeColor(x), k); then clamp luma to maxLuma unless the pixel is marked emissive (light-falls, sun, rift glow: up to emissiveMax); then a gaussian blur of `blur` local px over the whole layer (premultiplied alpha). hazeColor(x) cross-fades hazeColor -> hazeRift across biomeLocal.splitX +- fadeHalfWidth.

keyLight.note: same vector as world.js LIGHT: rims on up-left facing edges

riftLight.note: second rim on right-facing edges inside the rift biome

realm.mood: violet night, gold key light, cyan accents

rift.mood: crimson / magenta, ember light, torn space

corrupt.note: rect = the CR / CM outcrop footprint in world px (crystals, spire, green glows, glitch bands). cover = the share of the visible world rect that rect covers; at the hard east limit it is 0.23 (2560x1440, z 1.25) to 1 (portrait phones), at the start camera and every overview it is <= 0.09 with w.rift = 0
corrupt.mood: corrupted green accent around the CR / CM outcrop

biomes.weights: rift = smoothstep(from, to, C.x); corrupt = rift * smoothstep(corrupt.cover[0], corrupt.cover[1], cover), cover = |corrupt.rect ∩ view| / |view| with view = C ± V / (2 z) in world px (camera.js viewCover / biome(C, B, z, V)); both eased toward their target with tau 0.35 s (instant with ReducedMotion)
biomes.tintRule: tiles of layer L: ImageColor3 = mix(mix(white, L.tint.rift, w.rift), L.tint.corrupt, 0.5 * w.corrupt); the world (tint null) stays white
biomes.spriteColorRule: sprites with color {realm, rift, corrupt}: ImageColor3 = mix(mix(realm, rift, w.rift), corrupt, 0.5 * w.corrupt); sprites with a palette keep palette[c]; field particles: mix(mix(palette[c], kind.rift, w.rift), kind.corrupt, 0.5 * w.corrupt)
biomes.update: recompute when a weight moves by more than 0.01; write ImageColor3 only then

wash.rule: one full-screen Frame; colour = mix(mix(realm, rift, w.rift), corrupt, 0.35 * w.corrupt); BackgroundTransparency = 1 - mix(realm.alpha, rift.alpha, w.rift)

vignette.rule: full-screen ImageLabel above everything in the map (below the HUD); static

layers.name: Deep space
layers.keepClearRule: advisory: the layer is dim; keep the brightest nebula knots out of the soft zones

art.contains: domain-warped nebula, galactic band, dust lanes, a dense faint star field (bright stars are sprites), the cosmic sun at about (0.36 w, 0.26 h) with a soft corona; the right third leans crimson/magenta (the rift bleeding into space)
art.palette: void (7, 5, 13) to deep violet (32, 16, 70); nebula violet (179, 92, 255) / magenta / cyan; sun core warm (255, 214, 150)
art.feel: infinitely far: barely moves (5% of the world), fills every corner, never pure black
art.empty: no hard shapes; keep the band's brightest knots away from the screen centre band y 0.4-0.6 h so node plates read

atlas.rule: one sheet, regions below in HIGH px (LOW sheet = half size, same normalized rects). Every region fades to alpha 0 within its own 2 px border; alpha-bleed like the tiles. Soft sprites are drawn pre-blurred.

looks.wispA-D: soft, torn cloud wisps, white on transparent (tinted by ImageColor3), pre-blurred 6-10 px, alpha peak 0.9
looks.vineA/B: hanging vine with leaves, top-anchored (top-centre = attachment), silhouette white-ish grey so ImageColor3 sets the colour, pre-blurred 3 px
looks.vineThin: thin tendril with 2-3 leaves and a glowing bud at the tip, top-anchored, crisp
looks.lightfall: vertical luminous streak, bright core column, soft edges, fades at the bottom 30%; white
looks.glow: radial gaussian glow, white, alpha 1 at centre to 0 at the edge
looks.ring: thin soft ring (radius 0.42 of the region, width 0.05), white
looks.bokehA: out-of-focus disc: flat interior 0.55, brighter rim 0.9, soft 3 px edge, white
looks.vignette: radial: alpha 0 inside 0.55 radius to 1 at the corners, black
looks.star4: 4-point sparkle with long thin rays + white core (lib.js sparkle)
looks.stardot: round star: white core, 2 px halo
looks.firefly: warm core 3 px + halo 20 px, white (tinted)
looks.ember: tiny hot ember with a short upward smear
looks.bar: horizontal line, hard top/bottom edge, soft ends
looks.shardA/B: small floating rock shard with a crystal vein, rim lit upper-left, white-grey (tinted)
looks.streak: shooting star: bright head on the right, tail fading to the left

budget.note: RGBA8 bytes of every uploaded image (tiles include their gutters). withMips = x4/3 in case the engine mips GUI textures. Tiles the tiler finds fully transparent are not uploaded, so these are upper bounds.
